NFL DFS Running Back Rankings: Week 10 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 15 · 10 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 12, 9:26 AM ET

Bijan Robinson is the top-projected running back on the Week 10 DraftKings main slate at 25.3 DraftKings points for $8,200, against Kansas City. Kenneth Walker III (22.6, $9,200) and Christian McCaffrey (20.8, $8,500) are next.

Bijan Robinson is also the top value at the position: 3.08 projected points per $1,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 12, 9:26 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Running backs to know in Week 10

Bijan Robinson, ATL vs KC ($8,200)

Bijan Robinson carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 25.3 DraftKings points at $8,200, the highest on the entire main slate. That is 2.7 points clear of Kenneth Walker III. The model gives him 21.0 carries and 4.8 targets. The salary works out to 3.08 projected points per $1,000, 1st of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Robinson averaged 25.2 points with a simulated floor of 12.8 and a ceiling of 42.2, and he holds 42% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Atlanta is a 3-point underdog at home against Kansas City, with an implied team total of 21.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Kenneth Walker III, KC at ATL ($9,200)

Kenneth Walker III projects 2nd at the position with 22.6 DraftKings points at $9,200, 2nd on the main slate overall. The model gives him 18.9 carries and 4.0 targets. The salary works out to 2.45 projected points per $1,000, 6th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Walker averaged 22.5 points with a simulated floor of 10.2 and a ceiling of 39.8, and he holds 10% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Kansas City is a 3-point favorite on the road against Atlanta, with an implied team total of 24.75 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Christian McCaffrey, SF at DAL ($8,500)

Christian McCaffrey projects 3rd at the position with 20.8 DraftKings points at $8,500, 5th on the main slate overall. The model gives him 12.9 carries and 5.6 targets. The salary works out to 2.45 projected points per $1,000, 7th of 21 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations McCaffrey averaged 20.9 points with a simulated floor of 9.0 and a ceiling of 39.0, and he holds 19% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. San Francisco is a 3.5-point favorite on the road against Dallas, with an implied team total of 29.5 in a game totaled at 55.5.

Value: Ashton Jeanty, LV vs SEA ($5,400)

Ashton Jeanty projects for 13.4 DraftKings points at $5,400, which works out to 2.48 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 21 running backs the model projects for 9 or more points. The model gives him 10.8 carries and 5.7 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Jeanty averaged 13.2 points with a simulated floor of 3.8 and a ceiling of 29.4, and he holds 9% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Las Vegas is a 6.5-point underdog at home against Seattle, with an implied team total of 17 in a game totaled at 40.5.
